distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Ambrosiophilus cristatulus from Fujian. Smith et al. (2022) confirms Fujian and adds Yunnan, including Honghe locality evidence. The reviewed current distribution is the union Fujian and Yunnan.

host_note: No host was reported in the promoted Smith et al. (2020) source record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ambrosiophilus cristatulus (Schedl, 1953).

taxonomic_history.name: Ambrosiophilus cristatulus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The original combination is retained in the nomenclatural history; no additional synonyms are currently linked in the integrated backbone.
